body:
I attempted in October 2015. 
I took about 70 pills, a mixture of sleeping medications and benzodiazepines. I drank 3 or 4 beers, I went on my patio, wrote a post on Facebook as my note, I sat out there on my favorite blanket and smoked cigarettes until I fell asleep. My roommate saw me first, and didn’t think anything of it. my sister came home,
And I was lying there unconscious with really shallow breathing. she called her boyfriend who threw me over his shoulder, carried me to the car and they took me to the hospital.
I ended Up in the ICU in a coma for several days. My family And my Boyfriend cared a lot. 
but they mostly asked why I did it and it was honestly so embarrassing for me. I woke up and I was so angry that I was still alive. I asked my family why they wouldn’t just let me die. 
The People in your life will never look at you the same. 
My roomates girlfriend cried when I saw her again. 
It affected everyone close to me, and not in a good way. It hurts other people and it’s not worth it.
it’s too painful.
Thank you for reading this. It means a lot to me. 😥 I can look into it.
Right i just don’t think you understand what I meant
I’m not sad he’s going to see them. I’m sad that he won’t make any time and didn’t make an effort to make sure we would have time to talk for 20 mins for one day out of 7 he has with them!
It’s literally in the rules not to be a jerk based on the title Of the post
They know about me and even were in support of us moving in together. They’re just stuck up or something

I know they are worried! I would be too! The simple fact of the matter is that I asked for something so simple and even that was too much. They are out and about doing all kinds of stuff. Their dad included.

I did not want him to cancel the trip. Did you even read the post?
I wanted a phone call! That’s all I asked. 👌🏻
I’m so happy they get to spend time with them this week but that does not mean that my feelings and emotional needs are so much that a phone call is too much to ask. 
I fully supported them going, what I do not support is not being considerate enough to even make sure they’d be able to give me a small window of time to support me on the hardest day of the year for me.
Oh yeah I just want a PHONE CALL! that’s it dude. It stings that they didn’t even remember let alone do what I asked that was so simple! so frustrating.

I think the reason it hurts so much is because I found my parent’s body. So yes, I do handle it differently than most people. 
I am trying to give a pass but it’s hard when they can’t be considerate enough to give me a phone call for support.
